title: nje-pass-brute
author: Soldier of Fortran
description: z/OS JES Network Job Entry (NJE) 'I record' password brute forcer. After successfully negotiating an OPEN connection request, NJE requires sending, what IBM calls, an 'I record'. This initialization record may sometimes require a password. This script, provided with a valid OHOST/RHOST for the NJE connection, brute forces the password. Most systems only have one password, it is recommended to use the brute.firstonly script argument.
